gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~760, breakout level ~776 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~780.

plain_english.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
because: SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
SPY sits 0.68 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits -0.14 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.92 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Enterprise Software, Homebuilders, Gold Miners — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
plain_english.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
